crossRefs.note: but you said, “No, for we will flee on horses;” therefore you will flee; and, “We will ride on the swift;” therefore…
They will be dismayed and confounded, because of Ethiopia their expectation, and of Egypt their glory.
The inhabitants of this coast land will say in that day, ‘Behold, this is our expectation, where we fled for help to be…
Woe to those who go down to Egypt for help, and rely on horses, and trust in chariots because they are many, and in…
Why do you go about so much to change your ways? You will be ashamed of Egypt also, as you were ashamed of Assyria.

translations.web: They shall all be ashamed because of a people that can’t profit them, that are not a help nor profit, but a shame, and also a reproach.”
translations.bsb: everyone will be put to shame because of a people useless to them. They bring neither help nor benefit, but only shame and disgrace.”
translations.kjv: They were all ashamed of a people that could not profit them, nor be an help nor profit, but a shame, and also a reproach.
translations.asv: They shall all be ashamed because of a people that cannot profit them, that are not a help nor profit, but a shame, and also a reproach.
